name: Chip Hope Co., Ltd
summary: Chip Hope Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, production, and distribution of computer hardware and associated software solutions. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a broad spectrum of technological goods, including electronic components, semiconductors, and various types of equipment such as communications gear, machinery, electrical apparatus, general instrumentation, and advanced optical and precision devices. They also supply medical equipment, metrology and measuring instruments, and a range of computer and software products. Notably, their offerings extend to specialized items like integrated caller ID telephone modules and switch systems, alongside cutting-edge AI smart hearing aids. Beyond its tech ventures, Chip Hope diversifies its operations into the hospitality sector, managing hotels, restaurants, recreational facilities, and hot springs, in addition to engaging in food wholesale and catering services. The company also dedicates resources to the research and development of biotech medical products and maintains a general investment portfolio. Established in 1982, Chip Hope Co., Ltd. has its headquarters situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
